Dr. Broersma is a professor and the Thesis Director for the MA TESOL at LCC. He is also a professor of TESOL and Linguistics in the Languages and Literature Department at Lee University in Cleveland, TN in the U.S. Before beginning to work at Lee in 2014, Dr. Broersma lived and worked in Moscow, Russia for 17 years at the Russian-American Christian University and Hinkson Christian Academy.
